description: Wallet-signed recipient confirmation (finding D, twenty-second review): the SE plus a DE whose s3_attestation carries a wallet advanced electronic signature (wallet_signature_b64) and a device_id. bundle_lint LINT-BND-21 resolves the confirming device's PUBLISHED confirmation_key anchor per (mid, device_id) from the BW-MEMBER set and VERIFIES the signature against it — the reference-verifier check at lint time. Recipient-side entity EU-FR-PSBID (as in bundle.default). Paths are relative to this manifest's directory.
